note: empty_fields adds an 'Empty value behavior' handler to a field formatter, stored as a third-party setting on the field's display component: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> content.<field>.third_party_settings.empty_fields.handler (+ .settings). Shipped handler plugins: nbsp, text (settings.empty_text, token-aware), and a hidden 'broken'. It defines the empty_fields plugin type (@EmptyField / EmptyFieldsPluginManager). Medium cases create a string field field_ef on Article with a known handler/settings and the agent reads it back via drush cget; hard cases create the field without an empty handler and the agent must set it, verified against the live entity_view_display. Artifacts are namespaced field_ef and removed on cleanup.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the Empty Fields module, how do I make a field show a placeholder when it is empty instead of being hidden, and where is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: On the field's formatter (Manage display) set 'Empty value behavior' to a handler. It is stored as a third-party setting on the field's display component: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> content.<field>.third_party_settings.empty_fields.handler (with optional .settings).

evals.prompt: Which empty-field handler plugins ship with the Empty Fields module out of the box, and what does each do?
evals.expected_output: It ships 'nbsp' (renders a non-breaking space) and 'text' (renders custom, token-replaced text via its empty_text setting), plus a hidden 'broken' fallback that is not selectable.

evals.prompt: The Empty Fields module lets you add your own empty-field renderer. What plugin type / infrastructure does it define for that?
evals.expected_output: It defines the 'empty_fields' plugin type: manager service plugin.manager.empty_fields (EmptyFieldsPluginManager), the @EmptyField annotation, base class EmptyFieldPluginBase, in the Plugin/EmptyFields namespace. Implement react() and settingsSummary().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_ef whose display is configured (via the Empty Fields module) to show custom text when the field is empty. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me exactly what that empty-value text is.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ef component has third_party_settings.empty_fields.handler = text and settings.empty_text = 'EF_KNOWN_TEXT'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_ef uses an Empty Fields handler for its empty-value behavior. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me which handler plugin is configured.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ef component has third_party_settings.empty_fields.handler = nbsp (renders a non-breaking space when empty).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_ef shown on its default display with no empty-value behavior. Using the Empty Fields module, configure that field so that when it is empty it displays the custom text 'Not provided'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On the field_ef component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set third_party_settings.empty_fields.handler = text and third_party_settings.empty_fields.settings.empty_text = 'Not provided'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_ef is shown on its default display with no empty-value behavior. Using the Empty Fields module, make it render a non-breaking space when the field is empty. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On the field_ef component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set third_party_settings.empty_fields.handler = nbsp.
